records.name: Tinkinswood burial chamber
records.date_basis: Approximate construction date in the cited teaching chronology; not an occupation interval.
records.summary: A communal burial monument provides evidence of Neolithic life long before named rulers appear in surviving accounts.
records.location_note: Approximate vicinity of the monument, not a surveyed footprint.

records.name: Bryn Celli Ddu · henge phase
records.date_basis: The source dates the henge phase, not the later tomb or continuous use of the site.
records.summary: A henge preceded the passage tomb visible today. Separate phases at a place must not be collapsed into one unchanging community.
records.location_note: Approximate monument vicinity; the date is specifically for the earlier henge.

records.name: Hillfort-building communities in Wales
records.date_basis: A broad archaeological-period overview, not a continuous occupation date for an individual fort or a tribe's lifetime.
records.summary: Fortified hilltops are evidence of organised communities. A broad building tradition cannot establish the borders of a single Celtic kingdom.
records.location_note: Illustrative regional anchor only. It is not a settlement, capital or territorial centre.

records.name: Llyn Fawr · bronze and iron deposits
records.date_basis: Dating of deposited metalwork. It does not establish a single deposition year or local smelting.
records.summary: Bronze and iron objects were placed in the lake. Possible ritual deposition is an interpretation; the objects also attest access to metalworking traditions.
records.location_note: Approximate lake vicinity. Manufacture location is not established by the findspot.

records.name: Llyn Cerrig Bach · iron chariot tyre
records.date_basis: Museum dating range for the object, not a ruler's reign or one dated battle.
records.summary: An iron wheel tyre records skilled working of iron in a chariot component. Its findspot does not establish where its iron was smelted.
records.location_note: Approximate lake/find area on Anglesey, not its current museum display location.

records.name: Cassivellaunus
records.date_basis: Literary attestation during Caesar's second expedition; not an inferred reign.
records.evidence: Roman literary account, discussed by a university source
records.summary: Caesar describes a leader of the British resistance. His tribal identity is not specified by Caesar, despite later associations.
records.location_note: Broad regional illustration, not a camp, battle site or kingdom boundary.

records.name: Tasciovanus
records.date_basis: The cited coin's approximate dating range. It is not a precise reign or a complete series chronology.
records.summary: Coins associate this ruler with Verlamion. The distribution of his coinage cannot be treated as a surveyed kingdom boundary.
records.location_note: City-area anchor for an associated mint/centre, not the findspot of the illustrated coin.

records.name: Cunobelinus / Cunobelin
records.date_basis: Museum description's ruler dating; uncertainty over the terminal year is retained.
records.summary: A surviving coin names Cunobelin and Tasciovanus. The inscription supports an ancestral claim, rather than an exact map of political control.
records.location_note: Illustrative regional anchor, not the coin's findspot or the boundary of a unified Britain.

records.name: Caratacus / Caradog
records.date_basis: Dated episode in the cited historical discussion. This is not a reign or the date of a securely located battle.
records.summary: Caratacus organised resistance involving the Silures and Ordovices. The location of his final defeat is disputed among several suggested sites.
records.location_note: Broad borderlands anchor only. No proposed battlefield is selected as the definitive location.

records.name: Silures · resistance episode
records.date_basis: Association in the Caratacus resistance episode; not a foundation date or the group's full existence.
records.summary: The source names the Silures among the communities involved in resistance to Rome. The marker does not turn that name into a fixed bounded state.
records.location_note: Illustrative Welsh regional association. No boundary, capital or exact gathering place is claimed.

records.name: Ordovices · resistance episode
records.date_basis: Association in the Caratacus resistance episode; not a foundation date or the group's full existence.
records.evidence: historical community name and debated site association
records.summary: The source names the Ordovices and discusses a proposed stronghold. Such suggestions do not establish a securely mapped tribal territory.
records.location_note: Illustrative Welsh regional anchor. The proposed Cefn Carnedd association remains uncertain.
